model_details.name: SAMEER-DMDc Spectral Atmospheric Chemistry Emulator
model_details.framework: Dynamic Mode Decomposition with Control (DMDc) / Koopman Operator Theory

scientific_foundation.teacher_simulation: WRF-Chem v4.5.1 with Two-Way Aerosol-Radiation Coupling (aer_ra_feedback=1)

data_provenance.normalization_policy: Strictly fit on training data only

intended_use.primary_application: Real-time 72-hour coupled air quality forecasting and intervention scenario testing for Delhi NCR

uncertainty_methodology.method: Analytical residual covariance error propagation: Sigma_k = A * Sigma_{k-1} * A^T + Sigma_w

limitations_and_boundary_conditions: Linear Operator Approximation: Assumes atmospheric dynamics can be projected into a finite-dimensional linear Koopman subspace.
Extrapolation Limits: Extreme unprecedented emission shocks far outside training distribution may exhibit reduced accuracy.
Nonlinear Regime Shifts: Abrupt deep convective thunderstorms or severe synoptic frontal passages require updated lateral boundary forcing.
